About us

S + A specialized in architectural visualization, located in HongKong. Our core team consists of a multidisciplinary designers. We has always been committed to creating valuable services for global customers. Our visualization services include Renderings, Animation & Multimedia and VR 360 project types include airports, stadiums, city planning, high-rise buildings, hotels, residences, museums, performing art centers, art museums, research laboratories, educational facilities, hospital, corporate headquarters and urban complexes, etc. From the model details, to light portrayal, to material performance, we spirit of our team allows us to create architectural works that meet customer needs, The professional and innovative spirit of our team allows us to create architectural works that meet customer needs, and reflect the original design intent through the process of our services. SA+ Team has a growing collective intelligence, a collection of resources and creativity, in which the success of our customers is our pride and common goal.

ESSENSE 501 | Renderings by SAPLUS (S+A)

We are pleased to share our visualization work for ESSENSE 501, the first designated project of the LA28 Olympic development program.
ESSENSE 501 will debut as the Nordic ESSENSE House during the Los Angeles 2028 Olympic Games. The project has been fast-tracked by the City of Los Angeles Office of Major Events under the Mayor’s office, reflecting its role within the broader Olympic urban activation strategy.

S+A was responsible for the architectural visualization and narrative rendering, translating the design intent into a spatial and atmospheric experience aligned with the Olympic context.

A project that connects architecture, culture, and global visibility at a city scale.
